fact: Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 37.9 per cent of tertiary graduates in Cameroon in 2021, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 31.7 per cent of tertiary graduates in Cameroon in 2022, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 31 per cent of tertiary graduates in Cameroon in 2023, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 27.7 per cent of tertiary graduates in Cameroon in 2024, by UNESCO's series.
